result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that renders largely well. A few minor layout and content truncation issues are present, but nothing critical.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel (Trattoria Piccol...) is cut off at the right edge with truncated text.
issues.suggestion: This is expected for a horizontal scroll carousel, but consider adding a partial peek with consistent spacing or a visible scroll indicator so users clearly know more items exist.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icons have inconsistent styling between cards—one appears as an outlined heart on a white/light background and another on a dark circular background.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the heart icon button background and styling across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' pizza card at the bottom is partially cut off by the fold, showing only the top portion of the item.
issues.suggestion: This is normal scroll behavior, but ensure card heights and spacing allow a clean partial reveal to signal scrollability.
